headline: Early evidence for production-risk screening. Target oil estimates still need calibration.
short_answer: There is a promising statistical signal for predicting sustained zero-production periods. We do not yet have a validated remaining-oil or acquisition-value result.

findings.title: A useful early signal for production risk
findings.summary: On the future-time test, the model reduced log loss for a sustained zero-production event by 61.4% relative to a training-cohort event-rate baseline.
findings.target: A 90-day spell with no reported oil or gas production, completed by the forecast horizon. The event remains recorded after a later restart.
findings.method: 500 whole-entity bootstrap resamples; nominal 95% interval; no multiple-comparison adjustment or p-value.
limitations: The baseline is an event-rate prior, not a strong history-based event model.
The target does not establish permanent abandonment, equipment failure or depleted reserves.
The estimate concerns the evaluated public-data cohort; target-area and commercial validation are pending.
The percentage is a reduction in log loss, not classification accuracy, operational savings or barrel accuracy.

findings.title: Production volumes remain a work in progress
findings.summary: The current general model does not consistently beat simple production baselines. Future-time oil, gas, water and uptime are worse on their primary loss comparisons.
limitations: The paired interval is for the mean squared-log-loss difference, not the RMSLE difference.
Some individual transfer comparisons improve; they do not establish a consistent forecasting edge.

findings.title: Seismic representation learning shows development progress
findings.summary: An independently audited development candidate improved retrieval top-1 by 3.83 percentage points against the prior checkpoint.
limitations: Only three repeatedly used survey clusters.
Nominal intervals do not correct for the 144-candidate search.
Evaluation seeds repeat crop and augmentation sampling.
This measures seismic representation quality, not High River remaining oil or recoverable barrels.

findings.title: Task-specific production models are being tested
findings.summary: Final selection and paired comparisons follow completion of the registered experiment.

validation_limits.holdout_note: Area and basin protocols share test identities; the operator protocol has entity overlap with training. Four protocol reports are not four independent confirmations.
validation_limits.prior_champion_comparison: Not comparable on the required matched identities and labels.

data_progress.summary: Public operator records, lease and well production histories, survey-catalog geometry and historical well logs have narrowed the inputs for a targeted pilot.
data_progress.remaining_gap: No verified complete package yet joins target-overlapping seismic, usable well ties, measured reservoir properties and allocated depletion history.
